subject: Computer Science
name: Circular Wait Always Causes Deadlock
description: Believing any cycle in resource allocation causes deadlock even when multiple resource units allow one process to finish and break the cycle.

subject: Computer Science
name: Mutual Exclusion Can Be Removed Easily
description: Assuming mutual exclusion can simply be eliminated for hardware resources like printers or write locks.

subject: Computer Science
name: More Threads Always Means Faster Execution
description: Ignoring context switching overhead, lock contention, and Amdahl's Law when spawning threads.

subject: Computer Science
name: Virtual Memory Makes RAM Faster
description: Confusing address space abstraction with hardware speed, ignoring page fault disk latency.

subject: Computer Science
name: Hash Tables are Always O(1) in Worst Case
description: Ignoring hash collisions and adversarial keys that degrade hash table lookups to O(N).

subject: Physics
name: Motion Requires a Continuous Net Force
description: Believing an object moving at constant velocity must have a net forward force pushing it (Aristotelian fallacy).

subject: Physics
name: Heavier Objects Always Fall Faster in Vacuum
description: Confusing gravitational force (which scales with mass) with acceleration g = F/m (which is constant).

subject: Physics
name: Scale Reading in Elevator is Always Equal to mg
description: Ignoring apparent weight N = m(g + a) during acceleration and deceleration phases.

subject: Physics
name: Friction Always Acts in the Direction Opposite to Movement
description: Failing to realize static friction between tyres/feet and the ground actually propels walkers and cars forward.

subject: Physics
name: Action-Reaction Pairs Cancel Each Other Out
description: Thinking Newton's 3rd Law forces cancel, failing to recognize they act on two distinct objects.

subject: Mathematics
name: Base Rate Neglect in Diagnostic Tests
description: Assuming a 99% accurate test means 99% probability of disease without factoring in low population prevalence.

subject: Mathematics
name: The Gambler's Fallacy in Independent Events
description: Believing a coin that landed heads 5 times in a row is 'due' to land on tails next.

subject: Mathematics
name: Confusing Correlation with Causation
description: Assuming that because two variables trend together, one must directly cause the other without confounding variables.

subject: Mathematics
name: Averaging Percentages with Different Sample Sizes
description: Calculating (A% + B%)/2 directly instead of weighting by group sizes (Simpson's Paradox).

subject: Mathematics
name: Probability Zero Means Event is Impossible
description: Failing to distinguish between impossible events and single points in continuous probability distributions.

subject: Chemistry
name: Equilibrium Means Equal Reactant and Product Amounts
description: Confusing equal reaction rates (forward = reverse) with equal concentrations.

subject: Chemistry
name: Catalysts Shift Equilibrium to Increase Maximum Yield
description: Believing a catalyst increases product yield rather than simply speeding up the time to reach equilibrium.

subject: Chemistry
name: Increasing Pressure Always Shifts Any Reaction
description: Ignoring that pressure only shifts equilibrium if there is a difference in moles of gas between reactants and products.

subject: Chemistry
name: Boiling Water Breaks H-O Covalent Bonds
description: Confusing intermolecular hydrogen bonding breakdown with intramolecular covalent bond cleavage.

subject: Chemistry
name: Exothermic Reactions Need No Activation Energy
description: Believing that because energy is released overall, the reaction starts spontaneously without activation energy.

subject: Biology
name: Osmosis Moves Solute Instead of Water
description: Confusing solvent flow (water moving to higher solute concentration) with solute diffusion.

subject: Biology
name: Cellular Respiration is Just Inhaling and Exhaling
description: Confusing organismal ventilation with intracellular biochemical ATP synthesis in mitochondria.

subject: Biology
name: Plants Only Do Photosynthesis, Not Respiration
description: Failing to realize that plant cells constantly perform cellular respiration 24/7 to power metabolism.

subject: Biology
name: Injecting Pure Water is Best for Dehydration
description: Ignoring hypotonic cell lysis, believing 100% distilled water hydrates faster without osmotic shock.

subject: Biology
name: Dominant Alleles are Always the Most Common in Populations
description: Confusing gene expression dominance with evolutionary allele frequency in natural populations.
